raw_response: Measuring AI citations involves tracking which external web pages, directories, review sites, and domain properties are referenced alongside your business when AI models answer user queries. You can measure this by examining the source links provided in citation-heavy AI engines like Perplexity or ChatGPT, auditing your web analytics for referral patterns, and using specialized AI visibility software that extracts citation sources and maps out which web domains influence the AI's recommendations the most.
notes: Level 1 raw response captured for Gemini P10.
